========================================
 Smart Visitor Management System (SVMS)
 Quick Install Guide — v2.0
========================================

REQUIREMENTS
------------
  - PHP 8.1+ with extensions: mysqli, gd, mbstring, zlib, openssl
  - MySQL 8.0+ or MariaDB 10.6+
  - Apache 2.4+ with mod_rewrite, mod_headers, mod_ssl
  - Composer (for PDF generation)

STEPS
-----
1. Copy all files to your web root:
     cp -r svms/ /var/www/html/svms/

2. Create the database:
     mysql -u root -p
     > CREATE DATABASE svms_db CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
     > CREATE USER 'svms_user'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'strong_password';
     > GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON svms_db.* TO 'svms_user'@'localhost';
     > FLUSH PRIVILEGES;
     > EXIT;

3. Import schema:
     mysql -u svms_user -p svms_db < docs/database_setup.sql

4. (Optional) Import demo data:
     mysql -u svms_user -p svms_db < docs/seed.sql

5. Configure the application:
     cp docs/environment_config.php.example config.php
     Edit config.php — set:
       DB_USER, DB_PASS, DB_NAME
       BASE_URL  (e.g. https://svms.your-org.com/)
       SMTP settings (host, port, user, password, from address)

6. Install PHP dependencies:
     cd /var/www/html/svms
     composer install --no-dev

7. Set file permissions:
     chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/html/svms/
     chmod 770 logs/ assets/uploads/
     chmod 600 config/keys.php   (auto-created on first page load)

8. Enable Apache virtualhost (see docs/deployment_checklist.md).

9. Set up cron jobs (edit with: crontab -e):
     */5 * * * *  php /var/www/html/svms/scripts/cron_email_queue.php
     0   * * * *  php /var/www/html/svms/scripts/cron_appointment_reminders.php
     */30 * * * * php /var/www/html/svms/scripts/cron_appointment_no_show.php
     0   * * * *  php /var/www/html/svms/scripts/cron_auto_checkout.php
     0   3 * * *  php /var/www/html/svms/scripts/cron_daily_backup.php
     0   7 * * *  php /var/www/html/svms/scripts/cron_daily_digest.php

10. Open your browser:
      https://svms.your-org.com/
      Login: admin / Admin@1234!
      CHANGE THIS PASSWORD IMMEDIATELY.

PRODUCTION CHECKLIST
--------------------
  [ ] HTTPS enabled and HSTS active
  [ ] Default password changed
  [ ] SMTP configured and tested
  [ ] IS_DEV = false in config.php
  [ ] Copy docs/htaccess_production.txt to .htaccess
  [ ] Cron jobs verified (crontab -l)
  [ ] First backup created from Settings > Backup
